privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.summary: This notice explains which personal data the company publishing these job openings processes when you apply through TalentFlow, why, for how long, and which rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, Art. 13).

data.title: What we store
items: Account data: your name, email address and password. The password is kept by the sign-in service (Keycloak) and is never visible to recruiters.
Profile data: name, email address, and the phone number and location you enter when applying.
Application data: your CV (PDF), cover letter, the job you applied for, the date and every change of the application stage.
Consent records: what you agreed to, the policy version and the date, and when you withdrew it.
AI screening results: a match score, matching and missing skills and a short summary.
Interview data: dates, interviewers and the structured feedback of the interviewers.
Audit log: who viewed or downloaded your CV, changed your stage, exported or deleted your data, and when.

purposes.title: Why we process it
items: To evaluate your application and run the hiring process for the position you applied for.
To keep you informed: you receive an email when your application moves to a new stage.
Legal basis: your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)), which you give when applying, and steps taken at your request before an employment contract (Art. 6(1)(b), § 26 BDSG).
The audit log documents access to your data so that we can prove compliant handling (Art. 5(2), accountability).

ai.title: AI-assisted CV screening
items: The text of your CV is compared with the job requirements to suggest a score and a summary for the recruiter.
Your name, email address and phone number are removed from the text before it is analysed.
The AI never decides. A person reviews every application and makes every decision (GDPR Art. 22, EU AI Act).
If no external AI provider is configured, a local keyword comparison is used and no data leaves our systems.

retention.title: How long we keep it
items: Your data is kept while your application is open.
You can delete your data yourself at any time in the candidate portal. Your profile is anonymised, your CVs are deleted and open applications end.
retention.automatic_one: If your application is rejected, your data is anonymised automatically {{count}} month after the rejection.
retention.automatic_other: If your application is rejected, your data is anonymised automatically {{count}} months after the rejection.
retention.manual_one: The retention period for rejected applications is {{count}} month. Expired data is anonymised by an administrator.
retention.manual_other: The retention period for rejected applications is {{count}} months. Expired data is anonymised by an administrator.
retention.unknown: Data of rejected applications is anonymised after the retention period set by the company.

recipients.title: Who receives it
items: Recruiters and the hiring managers assigned to an interview for your application.
Administrators, to manage accounts, retention and the audit log.
Technical service providers acting on our behalf (Art. 28): hosting, email delivery and, if configured, the AI provider, which receives only the redacted CV text and the job description.
We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

rights.title: Your rights
items: Access and data portability (Art. 15, 20): download all your data as JSON in the candidate portal under Privacy & Data.
Erasure (Art. 17): delete your data in the candidate portal under Privacy & Data.
Withdraw consent (Art. 7(3)): deleting your data withdraws your consent; processing before the withdrawal remains lawful.
Rectification, restriction and objection (Art. 16, 18, 21): contact the company that published the job.
Complaint (Art. 77): you can lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For questions about your data, or to have your sign-in account removed as well, contact the company that published the job opening. TalentFlow is a demo application; this notice describes how the software handles data.
